title: The reference versions, their rows and the lists of values belong to rwb-case, the rule registry to rwb-decision, and the legacy story names a reference data service that exists in no source
source: Ownership Map v1 reference_version, reference_row and lov_value (owner P3) and rule_row and rule_test_case (owner P7); context pack P1 (18 owned tables, none of them a reference table); legacy RWB-DM-014 AC1 to AC3 and its Data table
description: The legacy story migrates lov_value, reference_version and reference_row in the P1 Recovery data engine module, and its AC2 has a reference data service validate them. The Ownership Map puts the three reference tables with P3 rwb-case under DP-07 and the rule registry with P7 rwb-decision, and the P1 context pack lists 18 owned tables, none of which is a reference table or a list of values. No source says which service writes the extract, which holds the content hash and the approver of a version, which service approves a version, whether the rule rows travel to rwb-decision through the registry or through the reference contract, what the format of the extract file is, or how long the legacy tables stay read-only. AC2's reference data service exists in no source document. The WP fixes the contract dependency to RWB-P3-E1043-CON only and gives this story AC1, AC2 and AC3.
evidence: Ownership Map reference_version, reference_row and lov_value owner P3; rule_package, rule_row and rule_test_case owner P7; context pack P1 ownership rows (18 tables); legacy RWB-DM-014 Data table DF-REF-027 to DF-REF-033, DF-REF-159 to DF-REF-180 and DF-REF-181 to DF-REF-184; legacy AC1 (four ACE views) and AC2 (reference data service, rule row test case); Template and Rules R5.5 DP-04, DP-05, DP-07 and DP-15; WP B2-P1-013 C dependency RWB-P3-E1043-CON.
proposed: P1 reads the legacy cutover dump once, writes one file per Workbench-owned table code in the load shape of the rwb-case reference-data contract and posts it; rwb-case owns the three tables, verifies and approves each version, and serves it from rwb_case. The rule rows and their test cases stay with rwb-decision's registry and are not loaded by this story. The four ACE lists are read only through the named views.
